# nginxproxymanager_access_list

**`item` blocks cannot be read, as the password is not exported from the Nginx Proxy Manager API.**

Therefore, no client blocks will be available in the data source.

```terraform
data "nginxproxymanager_access_list" "test" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the access list.

### Read-Only

- `client` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--client))
- `item` (Block Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--item))
- `name` (String) Name of the access list.
- `owner_user_id` (Number) ID of the user who owns the access list.
- `pass_auth` (Boolean) Whether responsibility for auth passes to the host.
- `satisfy_any` (Boolean) Whether a request passes if it satisfies any of the rules.

<a id="nestedblock--client"></a>
### Nested Schema for `client`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) IP Address of a client.
- `directive` (String) Directive, allow or deny.


<a id="nestedblock--item"></a>
### Nested Schema for `item`

Read-Only:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Always empty, NPM doesn't return the passwords.
- `username` (String) Basic auth username.
